docs(site): in Code the person has nothing to do on the workshop page

## Intent

In the Code phase the agent builds largely on its own, so the person has nothing to do. The page should say so plainly.

## Key changes

- "You decide" in Code reads: "Nothing. Time for a coffee: the agent builds on its own and may come back with a question only you can answer."
